rv.q: It’s only fair that the mother of them all should get a bite of the action at last.

An open letter to Audrey II, the people-eating plant in the revival of the musical ”Little Shop of Horrors,” which opened last night at the Virginia Theater: Dear Diva: You’re still hungry, aren’t you, you insatiable vixen? It wasn’t enough that you starred in a creepy 1960 cult flick, then went on to wow ’em in the Off Broadway musical adaptati...
This busy but not always effective fellow has summoned all of his strengths for this assignment.

cn.t: Critics praise this revival's strong direction and R&B score, noting the show has successfully grown from its off-off-Broadway roots to fill a larger Broadway house with its peppy cast and affectionate camp.
